newsitem.title: NORWAY: NORDIC SKIING-AHONEN WINS WITH BRILLIANT SECOND JUMP.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-AHONEN WINS WITH BRILLIANT SECOND JUMP.

text.p: Finn Janne Ahonen kept his cool under pressure to win the normal hill ski jumping world title on Saturday.
Ahonen, whose last major feat was a team gold at the 1995 world championships, was a modest eighth after the first round with 95 metres.
But a splendid second jump of 98.5 metres lifted him to first place with a total of 263.5 points.
Japanese Masahiko Harada, 1993 world champion, was second with 258.5 and Austrian Andreas Goldberger third on 257.
